name: sherlock
description: Hunt down social media accounts by username across social networks
one_liner: Type in a username and it checks hundreds of websites to tell you everywhere that username has an account.
buyer: A freelance background-check or due-diligence investigator who needs to map someone's online footprint quickly for a paying client.
business_use_cases: A private investigator runs a subject's known usernames through Sherlock as the first step of a paid background-check report.
A brand-protection freelancer scans for a company's handle across lesser-known platforms to catch impersonation accounts early.
A parental-safety or dating-safety service offers a paid 'digital footprint check' on a username before a client meets someone in person.

money_ideas.idea: Per-search paid report service wrapping Sherlock with a readable PDF summary
Ongoing brand/impersonation monitoring subscription for small businesses

steal_this: Build a simple web form that runs Sherlock on a username and emails back a plain-English PDF report, and sell it as a $10 one-off 'who is this person online' check.
